item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: RC, River Islands win Riverbank tourney openers
item.description: Ripon Christian’s boys basketball team notched its first win of the season Thursday, holding off Big Valley Christian 68-55 in the first round of the Ron Peterson Tip-Off Classic at Riverbank.

item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: East Union begins quest for 4th straight title at Golden Valley tourney
item.description: East Union’s girls basketball team is two wins away from a four-peat in the Golden Valley Tournament. The reigning champion prevailed 45-41 in the opener Thursday while handing Merced its first loss of the season.

item.title: Lancers’ depth, defensive pressure too much for Foothill
item.description: East Union coach Dutch Ell wasn’t always pleased with the effort and execution during his Lancers’ home opener against Foothill on Thursday, but he was quick to remind himself that there is still a lot of time to get put it all together. Newcomer Ayande Johnson scored 16 of his 18 points in a tide-turning second quarter, while Lorenzo Jones did Lorenzo Jones things with a double-double to lead a 71-37 lambasting of the visiting Mustangs from Sacramento.

item.title: Only in Manteca? Greenhouse gas isn’t driving the proposed gas station pause
item.description: There was a time in the 1960s when it wasn’t rare to see some cities with a gas station on every corner of an intersection.

item.title: 32nd annual Tree of Lights honors loved ones
item.description: A cherished holiday tradition honoring loved ones was held Wednesday at Doctors Hospital of Manteca. The 32nd annual Tree of Lights Ceremony offered those in the community with the opportunity to recognize people who have impacted their lives via a memorial or honorary light.

item.title: MPD arrests a Manteca man on child pornography charges
item.description: A Manteca resident was arrested on Tuesday for possessing and sending child pornography.

item.title: Museum staging holiday open house this Sunday
item.description: The Manteca Historical Museum will be having its annual Holiday Open House Sunday from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m.

item.title: Veritas School 6th grader advances to state spelling bee
item.description: David Perez will be advancing to the California State Elementary Spelling Bee.

item.title: 3 SUSPECTS IN 48 AUTO BURGLARIES
item.description: Manteca Police are distributing still shots from security footage in a bid someone may be able to identify three individuals that broke into 48 vehicles in the Great Wolf Indoor Water Park resort parking lot.
